items.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
items.body: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

items.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
items.body: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.body: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

items.title: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness
items.body: Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Goes Live With Crypto Custody After a Five-Year Buildup
items.body: Deutsche Bank’s custody service now holds Bitcoin, Ethereum and three stablecoins for institutional and corporate clients in Europe.

items.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
items.body: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.
